notes.title: 1.02.010 - Many Final Boss Bug Fixes and Balances!
notes.notes:
Discord
Reddit

Hey there all!  

Nothing much interesting to report, so I'll let the patch notes do the talking.  

Cheers, and happy liberating,

-David III
Founder/CEO/Lead Developer
Pie On A Plate Productions

GGMT 1.02.010 Update Log-9/18/19

New Additions(1):
UI (1)
-Added FOV slider


Changes(15):
Pills (2)
-JELLY CHAMBERS jam chance decreased from 2% per shot to 1% per shot
-MR SWIMMINGTON number of extra lives granted increased from 5 to 7

Enemies (2)
-Enemies with current health of less than 1 will now display “>1/[MAX HEALTH]” instead of 0
-Increased every stage of POLYRAISER base health by 25%
 
Shop (4)
-Player will now simply respawn at the front of the SHOP if they fall off instead of dying
-Chromatic aberration image effect (blurring and color splitting) decreased by 80%
-Motion blur image effect removed
-BROKEN CEILING price raised from 2,000,000 to 25,000,000

Multiverses (2)
-Player physical effects (always on ice, speed, jump, sprinting damage etc.) are all reset to default upon beating the game to allow for easier movement on the final platform (only applicable to SAVE THE MULTIVERSE gamemode)
-Added glass panes between each of the final platforms on the final boss to prevent players from jumping to platforms not yet reached yet

Mechanics (2)
-Can no longer continue to gain score after death
-Combos can no longer be achieved after death

Weapons (2)
-Glass Hammer base mag size decreased from 5 to 3
-All weapons jamming time decreased from 10 seconds to 3.5 seconds

Other (1)
-MR MONEY BAGS cheat buffed.  Score given increased from 10,000,000 to 1,000 stars


Bug Fixes(23):	
Pills (1)
-Fixed improper narration for UNLUCKY when picked up in the SHOP

Enemies (2)
-Fixed issue where bosses and enemies in endless mode would sometimes get infinite or negative health
-Fixed issue where bosses and enemies in endless mode would sometimes give negative score

Weapons(1)
-Fixed issue where golden Glass Hammer would not be given the proper extra 50% damage and 50% mag size

Multiverses(7)
-Fixed issue where player would fall forever when falling off SHOP with multiple lives
-Fixed issue where player would fall, respawn, and fall, continuously on SHAKEY CLIFFS
-Corrected ALTERNATIVE MEDICINE details text on SHOP, as it failed to mention that it also cured ARTHRITIS
-Fixed issue where end sequence would sometimes not begin in THE PARTY ROOM
-Fixed issue where falling off a platform during the final boss with multiple lives would respawn you at the last platform
-Fixed issue where turret shots were blocked by themselves on final boss
-Fixed issue where killing a stage of the final boss instantly after starting that stage would sometimes cause the final boss to get stuck

UI (3)
-Fixed issue where Retro scan lines would sometimes not cover the entire screen on certain resolutions 
-Fixed issue where extremely large numbers would sometimes appear to be negative
-Fixed issue where STRING boss would not appear in the BOSS RUSH menu

Other (9)
-Fixed issue where the next level would sometimes load after the player has already died
-Potentially fixed rare issue where player would continuously spin forever without the player touching an input device
-Fixed issue where game would sometimes crash on launch for those on Windows 7 machines
-Fixed typo in Steam achievement
-Fixed typo in the flavor text of TINDER
-Fixed typo in pill description of INVISIBLE in the SHOP
-Fixed issue where ENDLESS MODE just wasn’t working
-Fixed issue where the ending sequence at the end of SAVE THE MULTIVERSE would not complete should the player have already earned all the golden guns their max of 3 times each
-Likely fixed issue where camera would look straight up or down after the player unpaused the game or left their stats display menu

notes.title: 1.02.009 - Post Anniversary Update Patch
notes.notes:
GGMT Discord Community
GGMT Subreddit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33102035/9bc4ca620fa5222d7d224690cae342f0a6c69cc4.png

Hey there everyone!

First of all, WOW!  Thanks for the massive amount of downloads so far this weekend!

A lot of people were mentioning a few key points that could really improve the game, mainly talking about how the initial start of the game is too slow and frustrating.  So the Weak Pistol has been buffed by 20% to help accommodate for this issue! 

Movement has also been modified to feel less "floaty", and the player will not stop immediately after letting go of the move key, resulting in much more deliberate movement!

Mouse sensitivity and invert mouse are now options to toggle as well.

Now I know that there have been some annoying bugs that popped up already, but thankfully, this patch will fix a majority of them! (The more in depth/rare bugs are still being worked on though, don't worry!)

These fixes mainly address certain UI issues with the placement of stars and the spacing of scores.

In addition to this, players with non QWERTY keyboards will now be able to rebind their keys, allowing for more accessibility to all players!

The rest of the update log is below to check out.

Thanks again for all the growing support, and I hope these changes make the game a bit more playable and raise the quality of life!

-David III
Founder/CEO/Lead Developer
Pie On A Plate Productions

New Additions(2):

UI (1)
-Added epilepsy warning before game start

Other (1)
	-Added standard launcher so those with non-QWERTY keyboards could rebind keys as they needed

Changes(3):

Enemies (1)
-Decreased enemy texture shifting speed by ~75%
 
Mechanics (1)
-Player movement made significantly more snappy.  Player will now stop immediately after key release

-Weak Pistol base damage increased from 10 to 12

Bug Fixes(5):

Multiverses(1)

UI (2)
-Fixed issue where numbers would appear too far apart when playing on a machine located outside of the USA/UK and closeby territories

Other (1)

notes.title: THE GREAT GEOMETRIC MULTIVERSE TOUR ANNIVERSARY UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33102035/613ffb9bab7229bd009ab6a704d014d785607ab3.gif

Hey there all!  

In celebration of the GGMT being out for a year, we have an update for you!  This update contains plenty of bug fixes for bugs overlooked before the initial release, some gameplay balances and changes, but most notably: much better post processing.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33102035/9bc4ca620fa5222d7d224690cae342f0a6c69cc4.png

The addition of improved color-grading, bloom, depth of field, and overall lighting improvements makes the entire game look much better.  To reflect these changes, a new trailer and new screenshots have been added to the store page.


[previewyoutube=tMUxTc-XLYE;full][/previewyoutube]

The old ugly textures for the enemies and skybox have also been updated to look a bit sleeker and blend in more with the surrounding environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33102035/74f15f0fb051363157bc81675bf8ebc4df4aaf57.png

To celebrate this quality of life and graphical update, THE GREAT GEOMETRIC MULTIVERSE TOUR is now FREE to download from today until Monday, September 16th 12pm CST.  Download it once, keep it forever.  Now how's that for a lucky Friday the 13th?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33102035/00ccfa4d63750e87ab83d8c74bb126132c1dedfa.png

Well actually, this is some bad news: Old save files will not load in this version of the game.  This is due to a lot of things, but primarily is attributed to the game engine upgrade that was made in order to make all the other changes for this update.  However, this is the only and last time this will ever happen, so you can rest assured that all save files will be kept forever in tact from here on out! (Assuming we don't make a giant mistake.  Trust us, we really don't want to, but who ever tries to make a giant mistake?  But really though, it should be fine from here on out).

We hope to see the community grow from this update and giveaway weekend, so much so that we created a Discord and subreddit special for the GGMT!

Discord
Reddit

That's all for now!  We hope to release more updates for the game should a community begin to grow!

Happy 1 year ❤️

-David III
Founder/CEO/Lead Developer
Pie On A Plate Productions LLC

GGMT 1.02.008 Update Log-9/13/19
Changes(17):
Pills (1)
-SPICY TOES now heals you even in your own fire

Enemies (3)
-Added a slight glow to enemy projectiles in order to increase visibility
-Changed enemy texture for all enemies
-Improved collision detection for all enemy projectiles
 
Multiverses (7)
-Changed skybox on all levels
-Synced up skybox texture for all platforms (Mac is now no longer different than Windows and Linux)
-Skybox now slowly rotates on all levels
-Added spawn points for ACCIDENTAL TELEPORTATION to DEPRESSED AS HECK CONE FELLA boss
-THE MOST MAGIC BOI OF THEM ALL now waits 5 seconds before spawning enemies on initial level load
-TUTORIAL instruction text now easier to read against darker background
-Player now becomes immediately invulnerable upon killing a boss (prevents a death from a stray projectile only a second after killing the boss)

Weapons (3)
-Improved collision detection for all player projectiles
-Revolver damage increased from 25 to 35
-Strong Pistol now has bullet penetration by default

UI (1)
-Increased rate of update for scores that are very high

Other (2)
-Changed post processing rendering pipeline.  Post processing now looks a lot better
-Lasers are now slightly transparent


Bug Fixes(9):	
Multiverses(4)
-Fixed crashing on THE LUMBERJACK boss
-Fixed issue where THE MOST MAGIC BOI OF THEM ALL would sometimes not take enough damage from reflected lightning strikes
-Fixed score and proper death text not appearing when dying on SPIKEY SPIKE ARENA
-Fixed issue where player health would not sink beneath 5 on VOLCANO

UI (2)
-Fixed issue where stars UI would not disappear after dipping beneath 1 star worth of points
-Fixed issue where Endless Mode menu would not disappear properly when going back to the Play Menu

Other (3)
-Fixed issue where screen resolution would sometimes not be detected properly on first launch
-Fixed issue where quality settings would default to the lowest possible settings in some instance on first launch
-Fixed issue where SAVE THE MULTIVERSE button at the end of TUTORIAL would sometimes bring player to the main menu

Optimizations(2):	
-Optimized many UI elements
-Optimized enemy deaths
